summary: World 01 REL owner. Binary-exact and closed: the .rodata ordering gap that the campaign chased was resolved by #pragma section code_type with file-qualified ldscript selectors, not by any source-only construct. What remains is source-shape debt - the accepted shape relies on a compiler control - and an unresolved question about whether dtk reconstructs .rodata faithfully per translation unit.

evidence.summary: configure.py:1146 is Object(Matching, "REL/w01Dll/world01.c") with mw_version GC/2.7, and the exception w01-world01-exact-source-shape records the retained owner as byte-exact across .text, .rodata, .data, .bss and 5,673 relocations. The .rodata ordering defect described in the campaign write-up is therefore closed in this tree.

The accepted mechanism is #pragma section code_type ".text.common" / ".text.after_common" at src/REL/w01Dll/world01.c:399, :486 and :6411, paired with file-qualified ldscript selectors in configure.py:301 rel_ldscript_replacements["w01Dll"], which name world01.o(.text), world01.o(.text.common) and world01.o(.text.after_common) ahead of *(.text).

REJECTED as the source shape: every source-only route probed for prefixing .rodata. An extern-inline function-local static under #pragma cplusplus on, and a plain unreferenced file-scope static const, both prefix .rodata at zero .text cost but are diagnostic levers with no owner evidence behind them; an uncalled static function prefixes the pool but is never dead-stripped, and the best whole-object source-only construction reached .rodata byte-identical at 1,088 while costing +308 bytes of .text. Compiler build, -inline and -str flag sweeps were eliminated as levers. Do not re-run these.

debt.summary: Binary identity is reached through a compiler control rather than a natural declaration order. No zero-.text-cost source-only arrangement was found that creates the 19 hot constants before the first function is code-generated, so whether the original source achieved this ordering without #pragma section is unresolved. The pragma is authenticated by w01-world01-exact-source-shape as the retained mechanism; it is not evidence that the original wrote one.

It is unconfirmed whether dtk reconstructs .rodata faithfully per translation unit. dtk splits the linked REL by address range, so a TU contributing .rodata but no .text would be invisible to the splitter and its constants attributed to the neighbouring object. The concrete tell: world01.o is the only one of 21 REL target objects whose first text->rodata reference (0x78) is not its lowest referenced offset (0x10). This figure is carried from the unpushed campaign branch and has not been re-derived here.
